title: US-001: Home explains the product and roles
body:
## US-001 · Home explains the product and roles

**Feature:** F-UI-1 · Product home
**Priority:** 1
**Effort:** M (2 story points)
**Type:** ui
**Status:** Done

### User story

As a renter who has just been sent this link, I want to understand in one screen what this tool does, so that I can decide whether to spend five minutes on it.

### Acceptance criteria

- **US-001-AC-1:** Given I open index.html, when the page loads, then I see the problem stated, a numbered how-it-works list, and all four roles named.
- **US-001-AC-2:** Given I read the page, when I reach the limits section, then it says plainly that this is a record and not legal advice or a verdict.
- **US-001-AC-3:** Given I am on the home page, when I click Start a record, then I am taken to start.html. (The page now exists; remaining US-002 criteria still open.)
- **US-001-AC-4:** Given I open the home page on a phone-width screen, when I read it, then nothing is cut off and I never scroll sideways.

---
Migrated from `paper-trail/tracker/` on 2026-09-02.

title: US-014: Work board lists every story in priority order
body:
## US-014 · Work board lists every story in priority order

**Feature:** F-TRK-1 · This work board
**Priority:** 2
**Effort:** L (3 story points)
**Type:** qa
**Status:** Done

### User story

As the developer, I want one table of stories with type, priority, effort, and status, so that I always know what to build next and what "done" means for it.

### Acceptance criteria

- **US-014-AC-1:** Given I open /tracker, when the page loads, then every user story appears as one table row showing its type, priority, title, effort, and status.
- **US-014-AC-2:** Given I click a story title in the table, when the page jumps, then I land on that story's full detail with its acceptance criteria.
- **US-014-AC-3:** Given I read the table top to bottom, when I check the priority column, then the numbers run 1 upwards with no gaps and no two stories sharing a number.
- **US-014-AC-4:** Given any story on the page, when I open its acceptance criteria, then there are between three and five, each written as Given / When / Then.
- **US-014-AC-5:** Given a story's status, when I compare its table row with the badge on its detail section, then the two agree, and the status is one of To do, Pending, or Done.

_This story built the in-repo work board. It is closed — backlog now lives in GitHub Issues._

---

title: US-002: Start form captures the tenancy
body:
## US-002 · Start form captures the tenancy

**Feature:** F-UI-2 · Start a record
**Priority:** 3
**Effort:** M (2 story points)
**Type:** ui
**Status:** Pending

### User story

As a tenant, I want to enter my address, move-in date, and deposit amount, so that every later entry is attached to a specific tenancy.

### Acceptance criteria

- **US-002-AC-1:** Given I am on start.html, when the page loads, then I see labelled fields for address, move-in date, and deposit amount.
- **US-002-AC-2:** Given address or move-in date is empty, when I submit, then I stay on the page, see one error message, and nothing is saved.
- **US-002-AC-3:** Given both required fields are filled, when I submit, then I land on the log page and see my address as the heading.
- **US-002-AC-4:** Given a tenancy has been created, when I look for a way to change its address later, then the tenancy details are shown read-only, because the log's entries are attached to them.

title: US-019: Entries are read-only once written
body:
## US-019 · Entries are read-only once written

**Feature:** F-EVI-1 · Evidence integrity
**Priority:** 19
**Effort:** M (2 story points)
**Type:** sec
**Status:** To do

### User story

As a landlord asked to trust a tenant's log, I want to know entries cannot be edited later, so that the dates mean what they say.

### Acceptance criteria

- **US-019-AC-1:** Given an entry is stored, when any code path tries to change its text or date, then the attempt is refused rather than silently applied.
- **US-019-AC-2:** Given an entry is displayed, when I look for a delete control, then there is none anywhere in the product.
- **US-019-AC-3:** Given a page is handed an entry to render, when that page changes what it was given, then the stored entry is unaffected, because the page received a copy.
- **US-019-AC-4:** Given the code is reviewed, when I search it, then no function exists whose job is to update or remove a stored entry.

title: US-027: API rejects edits to entries
body:
## US-027 · API rejects edits to entries

**Feature:** F-API-1 · The server
**Priority:** 27
**Effort:** M (2 story points)
**Type:** api
**Status:** To do

### User story

As the owner of the product's only real promise, I want the server to have no way to mutate an entry, so that append-only is enforced and not merely intended.

### Acceptance criteria

- **US-027-AC-1:** Given an existing entry, when I send PUT, PATCH, or DELETE to it, then the response is 405 and the entry is unchanged.
- **US-027-AC-2:** Given the storage layer, when it is reviewed, then no update or delete statement exists against the entries table.
- **US-027-AC-3:** Given the database account the API connects with, when its grants are inspected, then it holds insert and select on the entries table and nothing else.

As a reader who may be a court, I want dates set by the server, so that a wrong device clock cannot forge history.

title: US-030: One error contract
body:
## US-030 · One error contract

**Feature:** F-API-1 · The server
**Priority:** 30
**Effort:** S (1 story points)
**Type:** api
**Status:** To do

### User story

As a client developer, I want every failure to look the same, so that error handling is written once.

### Acceptance criteria

- **US-030-AC-1:** Given any failing request, when I read the body, then it has the same shape with a stable machine-readable code.
- **US-030-AC-2:** Given the server hits an unexpected error, when I read the 500 body, then it carries a request id I can quote and no stack trace, file path, or SQL.
- **US-030-AC-3:** Given two fields fail validation, when I read the body, then both are listed inside that same error shape, not returned one at a time.

title: US-031: Suite maps to story ids
body:
## US-031 · Suite maps to story ids

**Feature:** F-QA-1 · Automation pack
**Priority:** 31
**Effort:** L (3 story points)
**Type:** qa
**Status:** To do

### User story

As the developer and tester, I want each automated check named after an AC id, so that a red run tells me which promise broke.

### Acceptance criteria

- **US-031-AC-1:** Given the suite runs, when a check fails, then its name contains the AC id it covers.
- **US-031-AC-2:** Given the integrity stories (F-EVI-1), when the suite is tagged, then they are marked P0 and run on every change.
- **US-031-AC-3:** Given a story gains a new acceptance criterion, when the suite runs, then it reports which AC ids have no check, so coverage gaps are visible rather than assumed.
